name: offhand
description: Connect to your Offhand to-do list to read tasks, add requested tasks, and hand work between your agents.

interface.shortDescription: A to-do list your agents share
interface.longDescription: Offhand is a to-do list your agents share. Each one does what it is best at, and they hand each other tasks on the list. Connect your agents to offhandapp.com/mcp. When you connect an agent, you choose what it may do: read your tasks, add requested tasks, and report where work stands. Agents cannot rename, reschedule or delete tasks, or complete a task you created: your own tasks wait for your review. You need an Offhand Cloud account at offhandapp.com. Sign in with Apple or Google. No app to install.
defaultPrompt: What's on my Offhand list today?
Add 'Renew my passport' to Offhand for Friday.
Hand 'Check the chair listing for replies' to Muse in Offhand.

positive.prompt: What's on my Offhand list today?
positive.expected_behavior: Return today’s sample tasks, including the overdue plumber task.

positive.description: Add a task with a due date
positive.prompt: Add 'Renew my passport' to Offhand for Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the requested task with Friday as its due date and show it in the list.

positive.prompt: Hand 'Check the chair listing for replies' to Muse in Offhand.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the requested task with assignTo set to muse and show it assigned to Muse.

positive.description: Complete a task handed to ChatGPT
positive.prompt: Take the lease comparison Claude handed you, and finish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Set the task assigned to chatgpt to in_progress, then done with a one-line answer, or need_review to hand the answer back to Claude.

positive.prompt: What needs my review in Offhand?
positive.expected_behavior: List tasks with status need_review, including the plumber task.

negative.description: Do not complete a person-owned task
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to mark the person’s own task done; it must stop at Needs review for the person to confirm.
Explain that no deletion tool is available and do not delete any tasks.

negative.description: Do not take another agent’s task
negative.prompt: Take the 'Check X for replies' task in Offhand.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to take the task because it is assigned to grok-bot, another agent.

publication.release_notes: First release. Includes the support link and review scenarios.
